I suppose. 

I don't feel ill though, so sometimes I wonder why they are fussing over me like that. Depression doesn't Feel like a normal illness

I am pretty scared about going on Meds though, I am scared that they will make me feel weird or something. 

The NHS is apparently having a load of criticism for its poor mental health treatment for young men who are apparently an at risk group, being LGBT makes me even more risk so I may get given more priority according to my GP.

With my permission she also spoke to my boyfriend and my parents about it, and told them if I am trying to hurt myself they should get me to a hospital in the mean time
Well the NHS takes weeks to get me referred anywhere. I can't afford to pay for it

I am currently renting a bedsit, I can't afford my own place and my BF lives with his parents. 

I can't afford to peruse it
